title: Federal Income Taxation
audience: a law student in a U.S. JD program
purpose: Compute taxable income from the Internal Revenue Code: gross income and exclusions, deductions, depreciation, property transactions and basis, capital gains and losses, nonrecognition, timing, assignment of income, and tax procedure.

weeks.1: The structure of the income tax
weeks.3: Exclusions: gifts, inheritances, fringe benefits and damages
weeks.6: Personal deductions and the standard deduction
weeks.7: Property transactions: basis, amount realized and gain
weeks.9: Nonrecognition: like-kind exchanges and home sales
weeks.11: Assignment of income and family taxation

blocks.deliverable: Classify ten receipts as income or excluded.
Compute the deductible expenses of a self-employed taxpayer.
Compute depreciation and adjusted basis for business equipment.
Week 7 midterm; compute the gain on a sale of property subject to a mortgage.
Analyze a like-kind exchange with boot.
Compute a family's tax with a supplied rate schedule.
Submit the project; take an unseen 180 minute final in week 14.

project: Tax memo: for a supplied taxpayer with wages, a business, a home sale and investments, compute taxable income step by step with Code citations, and write a client memo on two planning options.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
